decisions.reason: The quoted sentence directly states 'CLN3 Batten disease, a fatal pediatric lysosomal storage disease.' The phrase 'fatal' is explicitly used as a descriptor of the disease phenotype. The disease CLN3 Batten disease is the grammatical subject, and 'fatal' (describing a fatal phenotype) is explicitly attributed to it in the same sentence.

The quoted sentence directly states 'antisense oligonucleotide-induced exon skipping can have therapeutic efficacy in treating CLN3 Batten disease.' The subject (antisense oligonucleotide-induced exon skipping) is explicitly described as having therapeutic efficacy, and the object (CLN3 Batten disease) is the entity being treated. This directly supports the therapeutic_effect relationship.
